name: todays-report
description: /report: tasks Claude finished today, this week, month or year, the time it worked, what the work was, which models did it, the API-equivalent cost, your streak, and an estimate of time saved at a rate you set. Counted locally, no model calls.

minutesPerTask.title: Minutes saved per task
minutesPerTask.description: How long one finished task would take you by hand, on average. The report's time saved is tasks × this; it is your estimate, not a measurement.

hourlyRate.title: Your hourly rate ($)
hourlyRate.description: What an hour of your time is worth. The report's value is time saved × this.
